description: This file contains a test suite for the App component of a React application, utilizing '@testing-library/react' and Jest to perform unit testing and mock external fetch calls.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Sets up a global mock for fetch to prevent real network calls during tests.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Clears all mocks after each test.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines a test case that renders the App component, verifies the presence of the title, and checks that fetch was called exactly once.
